reasons: Aggregation differs: the Datadog query sums nginx.net.writing across all matching series with no grouping, but the candidate wraps the selector in avg(), which returns the mean across series instead of the total.
Quantity and unit match: nginx.connections_current with state="writing" measures the same current writing connections as nginx.net.writing, in connections. The non-monotonic sum needs no rate().
Grouping matches (none in both). The $scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.

Outcome translated is correct because an exact translation exists; only the aggregation operator is wrong. The expected form is sum({otel_metric_name="nginx.connections_current", otel_metric_type="sum", state="writing"}).
